# Windows Python Embedded Runtime

This folder contains the extracted Windows x64 embeddable Python runtime used
by the SepsisCare Windows app to start the local demo backend without requiring
a system Python installation.

Source archive:
https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.12.10/python-3.12.10-embed-amd64.zip

Downloaded source archive SHA256:
4acbed6dd1c744b0376e3b1cf57ce906f9dc9e95e68824584c8099a63025a3c3

The extracted runtime includes Python's upstream `LICENSE.txt`.
